title: ExquisiteWRLD
description: Multiplayer roleplay modpack blending medieval kingdoms with rising steampunk industry. Expanded combat with diverse weapons, classes, and bosses. Deep cooking, rich building options, furniture, and balanced QoL mods.
body:
A multiplayer-focused exploration modpack built around immersive roleplay with friends. Set in a world where medieval kingdoms meet rising steampunk industry, it encourages long-term progression, cooperation, and player-driven storytelling.

Combat is heavily expanded with a massive selection of weapons, accessories, distinct classes, and challenging bosses. Players can specialize into unique roles — from frontline warriors and agile hunters to engineers and support builds — creating strong identity and teamwork in multiplayer.

Travel evolves with steampunk-themed trains, planes, and boats, opening new possibilities for exploration and trade between settlements.

Food and cooking are deeply enhanced with diverse ingredients and advanced recipes, making farming, taverns, and commerce meaningful parts of the experience.

A huge expansion of furniture and decorative blocks supports detailed worldbuilding, while carefully selected quality-of-life mods improve gameplay without breaking immersion.
